title: Pansonic
summary: The moment you step off you bed and into the desk, the separation of the world is at the most exceptional movement in an instance. The idea coming from your…
body: The moment you step off you bed and into the desk, the separation of the world is at the most exceptional movement in an instance. The idea coming from your mind as a psychological response to the music in your device, playing to the dance you bring to your portal of creativity. The digital world can identify your mood, the diaspora of social engineered prison of your mental state, the disregarding of private live of the creator, noise from the street, the people you live with and the connection on social network all is a force by your own network of your mentalism. The noise left you wondering how long you have time to work before your hours of creativeness is left, how emails and messages, shouting or bleeps from your laptop or cell phone starts to send you off into another space in front of you. The fact is clear, we are constantly bombarded with ideas, sound field and visual synthesia. When you sleep your mind have dream of unwanted messages, images or character of an unknown reason. The rime of state of sleep can be rather like the internet, the portal to a world you have yet to discover. (The SARC oncogene)

Discrete Geometry (2020) is a sequence of soundtracks that were made at the same time of the EP Hidden Gutenberg EP (2019). Under the same series but entirely using a different way to build the compositions from the same producer Naked Nuras Loves Rave. These tracks are entirely played using analogue synths and instruments and then following the same step with ADC to DAC for their use in the mastering studio by Anne Taegert at D&M, Berlin.

The concept behind the project is if human’s will find water on MARS. The planet exploration of finding water towards transport in a system of flow trap TAXON. The planet forms the furthest point of that network using the basic method of solenoidal, vector, block code and an algorithm of an artificial: machine made structure to create a never seen before geometry of hidden world landscapes in space.

Attuned to the shape of form structures with music concrete/experimental sound of predawn hip-hop in Hong Kong late night sessions. Taped cassettes, Minidisc and early sampling SSD format would change the directions of Naked Nuras Loves Rave's multitracks studio layout and back in to a post analogue movement with DAC-ADC using only selective loudness of these instruments and juxtaposition of percussion and modern drum machine(TR08) and loops, mixing down a live recording solo album.

title: Ficcioni
summary: Read the Reviews on Neural Magazine http://neural.it/2020/01/paul-prudence-ficciones/
body:
Read the Reviews on Neural Magazine
http://neural.it/2020/01/paul-prudence-ficciones/

'Weaving together the soft accents of field-recordings, microscopic sound fragments and modular synthesis, the pieces fluctuate between the machine-like and the organic, and sometimes combine the two to create a complex sonic ecology. With forensic precision modular rhythmic collages have been grafted onto subtle melodic phrases; stuttering percussive structures are held in orbit by elliptical sinusoidal drones. The pieces are seen as being audio-visual experiences without the visual part. The tracks create a sense of motion in space, kinetic activity and cue the existence of teeming entities.'

title: Simpler Times
summary: Shoestrüng is a solo project created in 2015. Shoestrüng comes from a variety of creative backgrounds but who's main creative expression are in the Fine Arts…
body: Shoestrüng is a solo project created in 2015. Shoestrüng comes from a variety of creative backgrounds but who's main creative expression are in the Fine Arts and Video and Film. His first musical forays in original compositions begin at the age of six. Since then, he has been in various musical groups collaborating in original music writing. The last few years has seen the birth of Shoestrüng as a means of pure musical expressions. At its most simple, engaging in the expression in the passing of time and space and the varied emotions of life expressed through succinct compositions that touch on the depth of personal and the reactionary journey when dealing with people, places and things. He calls Hong Kong home and has for 30+ years. This exposure has played heavily in his personalized approach to sounds and the aura of living in one of the most densely populated places on earth.
